summary: Preinstall dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: Package declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs', which auto-fires on npm install. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (hex-named identifiers, shuffled numeric/string constant array with a rotator function, no readable code). The package advertises itself as a React chatbot UI library, a purpose that has no need to fetch an alternate language runtime at install time to execute an opaque sibling blob. Executing an obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded non-Node runtime evades Node-based install-time inspection. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js share the same string-array/index-shuffle obfuscation style. Installing this package causes attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
